title: Mirabel and the Uniform
author: Isandro Nakamura
blurb: Theo Joubert, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
